# watchpoint_otlp_hosts (Data Source)

Lists the hosts the tenant's OTLP host metrics have been observed from in a rolling window, with the services seen on each. Only stable identity is returned; the live CPU, memory, disk and network levels the same endpoint carries are deliberately omitted, because a data source is re-read on every plan and a moving number would churn anything built from it. Requires the `apm_hosts` feature flag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Hosts the tenant's OTLP host metrics have been seen from in the last 24 hours.
data "watchpoint_otlp_hosts" "fleet" {}

output "host_names" {
  value = [for h in data.watchpoint_otlp_hosts.fleet.hosts : h.host_name]
}

# A wider, pinned window. The list is a rolling observation, so a host that stops
# reporting drops out of it: anything built with for_each over these hosts is
# destroyed when that happens.
data "watchpoint_otlp_hosts" "last_week" {
  from = "2026-09-10T00:00:00Z"
  to   = "2026-09-17T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (String) Optional window start (RFC 3339, UTC). Defaults to 24 hours before `to`. The API clamps the window to its own maximum scan length.
- `to` (String) Optional window end (RFC 3339, UTC). Defaults to now.

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (Attributes List) Hosts seen in the window, most recently seen first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts))

<a id="nestedatt--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) Reported CPU architecture (`amd64`, `arm64`, ...), if known.
- `host_id` (String) The host's `host.id` resource attribute, if it reports one.
- `host_name` (String) The host's `host.name` resource attribute.
- `last_seen` (String) Most recent hour the host reported (RFC 3339).
- `os_type` (String) Reported OS type (`linux`, `windows`, ...), if known.
- `services` (Set of String) Service names observed on this host in the window. A Set: the membership is unordered, so comparing it by position would fail.
